name: draggable-card-stack
title: Draggable Card Stack
description: Shuffled deck of portrait cards on a dark surface. Drag or fling the top card to send it to the back; press ← to pull the bottom card to the front. Supports images and videos, hover overlay, auto-play, and fully configurable stack geometry.
